The ''''Whistler' modified carbine''' was a heavily modified [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbine]] which saw use during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It fired [[Acid/Legends|acid]] filled ballistic rounds accelerated to extreme velocities. The projectiles created a distinct whistling sound as they cut through the air and their target.
